_published_faq.name: How do I add rentahuman.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add rentahuman.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://rentahuman.ai/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is rentahuman.ai MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, rentahuman.ai scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.
